name: uv_mutex_init

ownership.argument: Initialises a libuv mutex; the module serialises its queue work with the same primitive the firmware uses.

provenance.source: In ../../apps/system/libuv/libuv/src/unix/thread.c: initialises a mutexattr through 0xC1E990C, sets type 1 with 0xC1E9944, initialises the mutex with 0xC1E9968, and destroys the attribute with 0xC1E9930 on both paths.

notes: The lock and unlock wrappers in the same file need a second pass: they were not separated with producer evidence here.
